user.title: Solar Airco
user.description: Choose the power sensors and how often the controller should adjust the airco setpoints. Add aircos afterwards via the integration's "Add airco" button.

data_description.base_load_entity: Subtracted from PV production to calculate the solar balance. Leave empty to use the fallback value.
data_description.fallback_base_load_w: Used when the house consumption sensor is unavailable or not selected.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: The controller changes a setpoint by at most 1 degree per update.
data_description.increase_threshold_w: A setpoint is only raised when the solar capacity left is above this value.
data_description.decrease_threshold_w: A setpoint is only lowered when the grid consumption is above this value.
data_description.decrease_lock_minutes: After a setpoint was raised, it cannot be lowered for this many minutes.
